context.diagnosis_summary: Category E — test code error. The test SQL in TC-OIDC-22-01 (line 224) joins pg_constraint -> pg_class but does NOT JOIN pg_namespace. Migration 042 (non-GBL) is applied to BOTH public schema AND tenant_default (and every other tenant_* schema), creating an identical CHECK constraint on agent_bootstrap_audit in each schema. The query finds both copies and returns 2 instead of 1. Adding `JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = t.relnamespace AND n.nspname = 'public'` to the constraint query makes it return 1 (matches test expectation). The first part of the test (line 213-215) already correctly filters by `table_schema = 'public'` via information_schema.tables, confirming the test author's intent. The very next test TC-OIDC-23-01 follows the same correct pattern using pg_indexes with `schemaname = 'public'`.
